releases.title: Can Mechanical Hearts Feel Love
releases.description: A brooding analog synth piece from LIGHTBLEEDER. Slow-burn textures and a question posed in the title — answered only by the machine.

releases.title: Feeding Cigarettes to Pigeons
releases.description: A short, glitchy cut from LIGHTBLEEDER — warped samples and a tongue-in-cheek title riding on top of decaying tape hiss.

releases.title: Glimmer
releases.description: A bright, atmospheric sketch from LIGHTBLEEDER. The audio companion to overexposed film — a flash of light, then the room changes.

releases.title: Pineal Gland Decalcifier
releases.description: Esoteric frequencies from LIGHTBLEEDER. Low, droning synth beds with a title that does exactly what it says on the tin.

releases.title: Second Introduction
releases.description: LIGHTBLEEDER returns. A re-entry cue — slow build, feedback wash, the moment the visuals re-sync and the room comes back online.

releases.title: To Love Someone Like Me
releases.description: A tender analog piece from LIGHTBLEEDER. Warm pads and a vulnerable title that hangs in the air long after the track ends.

releases.title: Whatever U Like
releases.description: A short, bouncy cut from LIGHTBLEEDER — playful synth lines and a laid-back invitation.
